extracted.intended_audience: media organizations, journalists, and communications/PR professionals (dpa clients and prospects)
extracted.subtask_description: High-level standards and guiding principles for producing and delivering news/press-release content at/with a major news agency (dpa), emphasizing factual accuracy, credibility, journalistic values, timeliness, and client-focused delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Committed to the facts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is stated as the agency's core principle; implies that all content (including press releases delivered via the agency) must be factually accurate, verifiable, and grounded in evidence. Anti-patterns: speculation, unverified claims, or publishing without checking sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credibility and verification
rubrics_metrics.description: Credibility is our greatest asset: we stand for reliable and verified news in all formats.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content should be reliable and verified irrespective of format (text, audio, video). The agency prioritizes verification processes and consistency across delivery channels. Guidance implies processes to check facts, corroborate sources, and maintain consistency when adapting material to different media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journalistic values and competence as foundation
rubrics_metrics.description: No matter what formats and offers dpa trials now and in the future - journalistic values and competence are always the foundation. That is our guiding compass in all editorial teams.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editorial decisions and press-release handling should be guided by core journalistic principles (accuracy, impartiality, clarity, professionalism). This criterion covers tone, ethical considerations, and editorial competence. It suggests prioritizing editorial judgment over marketing spin when selecting or adapting material for news distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeliness and topical relevance (rapid topic detection)
rubrics_metrics.description: What topics are trending on social media? What are people talking about? dpa is all about rapid topic detection and tracking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content should be timely and responsive to trending topics; press releases intended for distribution via the agency should consider newsworthiness and social-media trends. Guidance implies monitoring public conversations and adjusting messaging/placement to maximize relevance and reach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Client-focused delivery and dialogue
rubrics_metrics.description: Intensive customer dialogue is essential for us as Germany’s largest news agency. As a driving force in the German media landscape, we are developing a wide variety of formats for exchange on all channels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes tailoring services and formats to client needs, arranging individual consultations, and working collaboratively to find appropriate distribution solutions. For press releases this implies consulting with communications teams on format, timing, and channels rather than a one-size-fits-all approach.
